description: This file defines the Review class within the Opencart admin controller event namespace. It manages event-driven tasks related to product reviews, including adding, editing, and deleting reviews, by scheduling background tasks goi ng specific model methods.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Handles review-related events by creating background tasks for add, edit, and delete review actions.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Schedules a task to handle review addition for a specific product.

methods.name: editReview
methods.description: Schedules tasks to handle review editing, including updating the review and handling product ID changes.

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Schedules a task to handle review deletion for a specific review ID.
